subject.title: feat: node-hosted plugins — dynamic tools, MCP servers, and skills

question: Should paired nodes be allowed by default to publish agent-visible tools and full local skill content without gateway-side registration or new operator consent?
rationale: The PR intentionally treats absent configuration as enabled, making this a durable upgrade, trust, and disclosure policy choice that code correctness alone cannot settle.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Keep existing upgrades inert until operators enable publication, avoiding silent skill-content disclosure or authority expansion.

options.title: Approve Default-On Trust
options.body: Accept paired-node publication as a first-class trusted capability with the proposed command, policy, and size limits.

options.title: Narrow Initial Scope
options.body: Land dynamic plugin tools first and defer node-hosted MCP and native skill publication for separate policy review.

recommendation.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
recommendation.body: Keep existing upgrades inert until operators enable publication, avoiding silent skill-content disclosure or authority expansion.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the strongest ownership signal across the node, plugin, gateway, and skills surfaces involved in this trust decision.
